The text is heavily distorted, appearing as gibberish or 'alien' script rather than legible English or any standard language. The layout mimics a standard restaurant menu with headings and list items, but the content is nonsensical. The lighting is warm, casting shadows that suggest a physical object, but the texture of the paper and the edges of the text show signs of AI generation artifacts.
